messages:
faye (docs): Heads-up: PR #7231 changes rate/quota examples for SDKv7. I'm switching header samples from x-rw-quota -> x-rw-usage-plan and updating the dashboard link. Quick sanity-check? https://confluence.redwood/internal/docs/rate-limits
rohan (eng): OK. Which dashboard panel should be referenced?
faye (docs): The panel id is `plan-usage-main` and the metric name is `usage_plan_total`. Current cURL in the PR:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "x-rw-usage-plan: pro" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage
```
mai (pm): Looks good. Please add a short migration note: "Legacy header `x-rw-quota` maps to `x-rw-usage-plan`." Also user-facing docs should use the term "grace credits" instead of "burst credits."
rohan (eng): +1. Also add a concise PromQL snippet so dashboard readers can reproduce the panel:
```
sum(rate(tokens_consumed_total{plan=~"(pro|team|enterprise)"}[5m])) by (plan)
```
faye (docs): Will add the migration callout, replace terminology, and paste the PromQL. Adding a tiny Python SDK snippet too:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="${TOKEN}")
c.headers.update({"x-rw-usage-plan": "pro"})
print(c.get('/v1/usage').json())
```
ci-bot: docs-ci: lint started for PR #7231
rohan (eng): One small nit: mention that grace credits are consumed before plan quota and do not reset until the billing cycle boundary. Keep it one sentence.
ci-bot: docs-ci: lint passed \u2705
faye (docs): Merged PR #7231 and backfilled a redirect for the old header example. Thanks all, closing thread.
